args.subject: Re: Refund
args.body:
Hi Marta,

Thanks for reaching out. I'd like to help, but unfortunately your latest charge of $12.00 from October 25th is outside our refund window. Our refund policy allows refunds on monthly plans within 14 days of the charge, and yours was 18 days ago.

If you have any other concerns or would like to discuss your account, please let me know.

Best regards,
Acme Invoicing Billing
